title: stage-gate.sh Performer 5 阶段协商
acceptance_criteria: L1 存在性: scripts/performer/stage-gate.sh 存在 + 可执行 + tests/integration/3-modes/stage-gate-test.sh 存在

L2 实质性: stage-gate.sh 真实读 state.json.mode, COMPLEXITY[claim/analysis/in_progress/test/review] 映射正确, 简单阶段 (claim/in_progress) 0 退出, 复杂阶段 (analysis/test/review) 按 mode 分流 (ai-auto→0, ai-copilot→2 写 ask file, manual→2 写 ask file)
L3 接线正确: jq 读 .mode 兼容缺失 (默认 ai-copilot), 错误 stage 报错, ask file 路径 .kallax/inbox/ask-{stage|manual}-<TICKET>-<STAGE>.md
L4 数据流动: stage-gate-test.sh 跑 PASS, 覆盖 claim + ai-auto 场景
